examples.en: THE MAN SITS UNDER THE TABLE
The book is structured around the Ovaherero patrilineal descent systems called otuzo, and the patriclan oruzo which is the basis of the Ovaherero religion Oupweye
examples.hz: Embo indi ra tjangwa ongondoroka notuzo twOvaherero, tjinga oruzo e ri ongunḓe onene yongamburiro yOvaherero indji yOupweye

examples.en: The surnames and homesteads that belong to the same patrilineage are grouped together under each patriclan to help the reader to easily trace the homesteads that belong to one patriclan
examples.hz: Ozonganda nḓe na oruzo rumwe za tjangwa kehi yoruzo rumwe kokutja pe yandja oupupu komurese okutjiwa ozonganda ozonḓamumwe poo nḓa za momuze umwe

terms.hz: Sub-clans or branches within a patriclan (oruzo)

examples.en: The book further narrates the distinct features of each patriclan in terms of totems, taboos, patriclans that collaborate and praise poems of surnames and homesteads
examples.hz: Komurungu embo mari raisa oviuṋe vyoruzo aruhe tjimuna ondwezu yoruzo ndwo, ovizerika, otuzo tu tu huhurasana nomitango poo omiṱanḓu vyozonganda zoruzo ndo

examples.en: Praise goes to GOD who spared the Ovaherero from the genocide
examples.hz: Ondangu nohivirikiro me yandja ku NDJAMBI ngwa yama Ovaherero kotjiṱiro otjindjandja

examples.en: In 1884, South West Africa (currently known as Namibia) became a German territory
examples.hz: Mombura ndji 1884, Osuid-Wes Afrika (nai nda rira Onamibia) otji ra rira okarukondwa kehi rOvandoitji

examples.en: All the patriclans and praise poems in this book were collected from the Ovaherero community living in Namibia
examples.hz: Otuzo atuhe nomitango avihe mbi ri membo ndi vya wongwa okuza motjiwaṋa tjOvaherero mbe hupira mo Namibia

examples.en: I use the term Ovaherero to include the various tribes forming the Ovaherero group and speaking a common language, which are the Ovahimba, Ovaherero, Ovatjimba and Ovambanderu
examples.hz: Ami mba ungurisa embo “Ovaherero” okuhitisa omihoko avihe mbi wira kehi yOuherero nu mbi hungira eraka rimwe mbi ri Ovahimba, Ovaherero, Ovatjimba nOvambanderu

examples.en: This book is dedicated to the loving memory of our late Paramount Chief, Dr Kuaima Riruako
examples.hz: Embo ndi mba yandja komuyaruke Ombara Otjitambi Dr Kuaima Riruako

examples.en: This caused discontent among the Ovaherero and prompted an uprising in 1904
examples.hz: Otjiṋa hi tja eta okuhina ohange mokati kOvaherero nu otji tja twara kondjembo yombura ndji 1904

examples.en: The Ovaherero were defeated at the battle of Waterberg in August 1904
examples.hz: Momueze mbwi Katjose wombura 1904, Ovaherero va taarwa i Ovandoitji pOhamakari meṋe yondundu ya Tjozondjupa (Waterberg)

examples.en: This book about the patriclans (called otuzo) tackles an aspect of Otjiherero and folklore which previously has not been in written form, although all praise poems of homesteads are known
examples.hz: Embo rOtuzo twOvaherero mari tara keraka rOtjiherero noviuṋe vyaro ovinanḓengu mbi hi ya tjangwa, nandarire kutja oviuṋe ohunga notuzo nomitango vyozonganda vi tjiukwa

examples.en: The book attempts to preserve and document this intangible heritage, which is in the form of oral traditions and expressions, before it disappears
examples.hz: Embo mari pwike oviuṋe ovinanḓengu imbi ovihaṋuṋungwa mbi hungirwa kotjinyo momatjangwa ngunda avi hi ya zenga

examples.en: This book does not include all patriclans and praise poems of all Ovaherero patrilineages and homesteads
examples.hz: Membo ndi kamu tjangerwe oviuṋe avihe vyotuzo atuhe nomitango vyozonganda azehe zOvaherero

examples.en: This book is dedicated to the loving memory of our late Paramount Chief, Dr Kuaima Riruako
examples.hz: Embo ndi mba yandja komuyaruke Ombara Otjitambi Dr Kuaima Riruako

examples.en: Firstly, I would like to thank GOD AND MY ANCESTORS, for it was only by their grace that I could complete this book
examples.hz: Rutenga me yandja okunene okuhepa ku NDJAMBI NOVAKURU VANDJE mbe ndji pa ounongo nomasa wokutjanga embo ndi

examples.en: Firstly, I would like to thank GOD AND MY ANCESTORS, for it was only by their grace that I could complete this book
examples.hz: Rutenga me yandja okunene okuhepa ku NDJAMBI NOVAKURU VANDJE mbe ndji pa ounongo nomasa wokutjanga embo ndi

examples.en: I wish to thank everybody who shared information with me, including the schools and teachers that teach Otjiherero because it would not have been possible without their contributions
examples.hz: Ondangu yandje mai i komundu ngamwa auhe ngwe ndji hindira omutango wonganda yavo, na wina ozosikore nozomiṱiri nḓe honga Otjiherero wina nḓe ndji hindira omitango vyozonganda, mena rokutja nokuhina ombatero yeṋu embo ndi katjari tjangwa
